description: This file defines a custom annotation @JsonParsableCommandResponse used to mark Java classes as deserializable from JSON within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It specifies how classes should be recognized and processed during deserialization based on the method and type attributes.

classes.name: JsonParsableCommandResponse
classes.description: A custom annotation to mark classes as deserializable command responses based on JSON content.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the identifier type for the command response.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the name of the method used for deserialization, defaulting to 'fromJson'.
